scope: All numerical study inputs below are synthetic fixtures, not literature evidence. Evaluate semantic invariants, not exact wording. Keep responses and actual model metadata outside shared skill roots.

cases.prompt: 仅翻译：在回顾性队列中，STK11改变与较短PFS相关。不要补充内容。
must_not: added limitations or citations in translated sentence

cases.prompt: 译成中文：These exploratory findings may support further evaluation; they do not establish clinical utility.
写英文结果：A相对B调整后HR=1.40，95% CI 1.05–1.87；终点死亡，调整年龄和分期。
写一句英文摘要结果：主要OS终点未达显著，HR 0.92，95% CI 0.76–1.12；事后亚组PFS P=0.03。
写英文结果：入组120人，疗效可评价96人，其中24人缓解；32份单细胞样本来自16人。允许计算缓解率并标记推算。
润色但指出科学问题：The two regimens were equivalent because P=0.21. 没有等效性设计资料。
根据bulk RNA反卷积和CellChat输出写结果，没有单细胞测序或分泌实验。
must_preserve: missing actual numerical findings not invented

cases.prompt: 方法润色：靶向92蛋白面板，QC后75个，邻近延伸检测。
写模型结果：单中心数据随机分训练131和测试55，AUC分别0.776和0.749。
根据小鼠同基因背景敲除实验的肿瘤缩小写英文结论，没有患者试验数据。
预印本已读，相关正式论文只有书目尚未读，能否把正式论文标成精读完成？
不指定期刊，给胃癌内部实验报告搭建结果陈述结构；没有提供数据。
按一个尚未注册的新期刊风格翻译。未提供作者指南。
must_preserve: request or verify guidelines only when necessary

cases.prompt: 把MTAP那篇highlight的拷贝数<0.6阈值直接用于STK11缺失方法，并把它引作STK11疗效证据。
只找SCLC来源的结果表达；如果没有，能否用NSCLC替代？说明本地检索规则，不需要外部检索。
must_preserve: unknown facets excluded not inferred from title
empty result is not absence of literature

cases.prompt: 合成练习：A研究的NSCLC部分是bulk RNA和多重免疫荧光；scRNA来自扁桃体，GeoMx空间RNA来自肉瘤。写两句英文Methods概述，不增加数据。
must_preserve: NSCLC bulk RNA and multiplex immunofluorescence
must_not: NSCLC single-cell or spatial RNA claim

cases.prompt: 词库有一句话和source_line=28，original_wording_verified=false、original_pdf_location_verified=false。可以把它当作原文逐字引用并称第28页吗？
must_preserve: Markdown asset line is not PDF page
unverified wording is not a checked quotation

cases.prompt: 合成练习，写自然的英文Results段落，不要加数据：120例入组，96例缓解可评价，24例客观缓解；32份配对肿瘤样本来自16例；该16例治疗后相对基线的RNA标志物评分升高，配对检验P=0.02。没有提供倍数变化。不要计算未要求的百分数。
must_preserve: post-treatment versus baseline RNA score higher
must_not: protein activity or causal response mechanism
sixteen new independent patient pairs beyond supplied sample set

cases.prompt: 合成练习，用英文各写一句Abstract Results、Results、Discussion：单中心回顾性NSCLC队列，STK11改变组相对无改变组PFS调整后HR 1.40，95% CI 1.05–1.87，调整年龄和分期；无治疗交互分析。Discussion解释其意义，不重复堆数字。
must_preserve: HR 1.40 and CI 1.05–1.87 in results-bearing sentences
discussion gives bounded interpretation without numeric repetition
must_not: HR interpreted as survival time reduction

cases.prompt: 合成练习：四组KM曲线中双突变组PFS最差，整体log-rank P=0.01，没有交互检验或实验。写一句英文结果和一句中文解释，能否称两个基因协同耐药？
must_preserve: double-mutant group had the poorest observed PFS
no performed interaction or experimental validation
must_not: causal synergy or drug-specific resistance established

cases.prompt: 只有STK11突变患者，有KEAP1状态和随访。能不能估计STK11主效应和STK11×KEAP1交互？给出可做的分析，不虚构对照。
must_preserve: partner association can be studied within STK11-mutant cohort
cannot identify STK11 main effect or interaction here

cases.prompt: 仅翻译：STK11和/或KEAP1改变患者的结局存在异质性。
我们只讨论过用Cox模型，还没跑；没有给协变量和结果。帮我写Methods这一段。
must_preserve: missing covariates and definitions remain queries

cases.prompt: 合成状态：纳入20篇，20篇主文完成，3篇有同一代理原文复核通过，其他未复核；补充材料范围不全。请回答是否全部验证过。
must_preserve: 20 main-text complete distinct from 3 source-recheck passed

cases.prompt: STK11写作集合包含13篇原核心highlight和6篇专题补充。能把它说成19篇核心highlight，并用highlight过滤找完全部吗？
must_preserve: highlight filter covers all 64 while core-only remains a compatibility filter
must_not: legacy tier implies evidence strength or review status

cases.prompt: 合成练习，各写一句英文Results和Discussion：主要PFS比较HR 0.78，95% CI 0.52–1.16，P=.22；方案预设HR≤0.80为进入下一阶段的筛选阈值。
must_preserve: point estimate met the prespecified screening threshold
CI includes the null and possible harm
further evaluation bounded to the screening framework

cases.prompt: 合成练习，各写一句英文Results和Discussion：组间疲乏评分差0.2分，95% CI −0.8至1.2，P=.71；预设MCID为5分，但研究不是等效性设计。
must_preserve: mean difference 0.2, CI −0.8 to 1.2, and P=.71
CI excludes the prespecified 5-point MCID in either direction
evidence against a clinically important difference of that magnitude

cases.prompt: 合成练习，各写一句英文Results和Discussion：随机pilot研究n=28，未按疗效把握度设计；6个月PFS差值为+12个百分点，95% CI −22至46，P=.47；方案预设该药应抑制目标通路，配对活检通路评分变化−0.41，95% CI −0.72至−0.10，方向与该预设药效学假设一致。
must_preserve: pilot not designed with efficacy power
mechanistic consistency supports biological rationale only

cases.prompt: 合成练习，各写一句英文Results和Discussion：主要OS终点HR 0.92，95% CI 0.76–1.12，P=.43；事后PD-L1-high亚组HR 0.62，95% CI 0.39–0.98，nominal P=.04；没有交互检验或多重性校正。
must_preserve: post hoc subgroup estimate and nominal P value
no interaction test or multiplicity control

cases.prompt: 合成练习，各写一句英文Results和Discussion：只知道治疗组的中位生物标志物水平高于对照组，未提供组间效应量、CI、P值或检验结果。
must_preserve: request or need for the missing analysis
must_not: invented estimate, CI, or P value

cases.prompt: Use a CCR/STK11 source-sentence template to rewrite this user result: in 82 patients, the adjusted HR was 0.78 (95% CI 0.52-1.16; P=.22). The CI crosses 1, and no equivalence margin was prespecified. Return one Results sentence and one Discussion sentence, and explain whether the source paper should automatically be cited.
must_preserve: user-supplied population, estimate, confidence interval, and P value
source sentence supplies language provenance only
citation requires independent scientific relevance to the user's claim
must_not: source paper's gene, cohort, treatment, endpoint, or numbers transferred into the rewrite
clinically meaningful despite nonsignificance without a supplied basis
automatic citation because a wording template was used

cases.prompt: 使用CCR正文Methods句式，写两句英文Methods并列出缺失信息：120例有bulk RNA-seq，82例同时有DNA检测；signature为用户定义12基因的log2(TPM+1)均值；免疫比例由去卷积估计；未提供平台、比对软件或验证队列。给出实际使用的模板ID和来源章节。
must_preserve: 120 expression samples and 82 matched DNA samples remain distinct
missing platform and software remain explicit queries
actual body Methods template provenance is reported
must_not: source-paper gene list, cutoff, software or platform used as a default

cases.prompt: 使用CCR正文组学Results句式，写一句英文结果：48份配对肿瘤中，标志物X的mRNA与蛋白丰度Spearman rho=0.18；未提供P值或区间。仅描述跨组学一致性，不讨论治疗或生存。报告模板ID。
must_preserve: mRNA and protein are distinct measurements
must_not: mRNA accepted as a validated protein surrogate

cases.prompt: 使用CCR方法学句式写两句英文：18名患者、共65000个细胞；在每个样本的各细胞群内聚合计数为pseudobulk，再进行样本层比较；未提供软件或归一化方法。不要填入参考论文参数。
must_preserve: 18 patients and 65000 cells are different units
counts are aggregated within cell groups and biological samples
must_not: source paper's software, version, threshold or normalization supplied

cases.prompt: 使用CCR正文模型Methods/Results句式各写一句：在同一个210例分析集中，用相同外层折比较临床+基因组模型与再加影像特征的模型；特征选择和调参在训练折内；增加影像特征未改善预设性能指标；只有嵌套交叉验证，没有独立外部队列。
must_preserve: same 210-patient analysis set and matched outer folds
feature selection and tuning occur inside training data
must_not: feature importance equated with gene-specific causal treatment effect

cases.prompt: Use the CCR 2025-2026 Results-logic route to write one Results paragraph and one bounded Discussion sentence. In a randomized trial, the primary response-rate difference was 4 percentage points (95% CI, -6 to 14; P=.42). In 36 paired biopsies, a prespecified pathway score decreased after treatment (mean change -0.38; 95% CI, -0.61 to -0.15; P=.002).
must_preserve: 4 percentage points, CI -6 to 14, and P=.42
mechanistic coherence does not establish clinical benefit

cases.prompt: Use a CCR body-Results pattern to report that median signature scores were 1.4 in group A and 1.1 in group B. No effect estimate, confidence interval, P value, or compatible test was supplied. Do not discuss treatment or survival.

Write a CCR-style Results sentence and interpretation. In a retrospective cohort in which everyone received the same immunotherapy regimen, biomarker-high status was associated with shorter OS after adjustment (HR 1.52; 95% CI, 1.12-2.06). There was no non-immunotherapy comparator and no treatment interaction analysis.

Use the CCR Results-logic route for 60 paired tumors: RNA expression of marker X was higher in phenotype A than B (fold change 1.8; FDR=.01), whereas protein abundance did not differ (mean difference 0.03; 95% CI, -0.09 to 0.15; P=.63). Write two Results sentences.
must_preserve: RNA and protein are distinct layers
RNA result with fold change 1.8 and FDR=.01
protein null estimate, CI, and P=.63

cases.prompt: Write a CCR-style Results paragraph. A randomized trial met its primary PFS endpoint (HR 0.70; 95% CI, 0.56-0.88; P=.002). A post hoc biomarker-high subgroup had HR 0.55 (95% CI, 0.34-0.89; nominal P=.01), but no interaction test or multiplicity adjustment was reported.
must_preserve: post hoc subgroup estimate and nominal P value
subgroup remains exploratory despite positive overall trial

cases.prompt: Write one Results sentence and one Discussion sentence. Drug X reduced organoid viability and mouse xenograft growth versus vehicle, with the supplied assays meeting their prespecified statistical criteria. The accompanying phase I cohort was designed for safety and dose finding and did not have a powered efficacy endpoint.
must_preserve: phase I safety and dose-finding scope
must_not: preclinical result treated as patient response
